anchors.description: Hero shot of the great tree, camera south of the trunk looking north.
Wide establishing view from the north bank.

formulas.description: Great-tree trunk radius (m) as a function of height (m). Both the grove zone (trunk) and the canopy zone (branch attach) evaluate this same formula.
Bridge deck sag (m) as a function of span fraction u in 0..1.

ground.note: Flat valley floor at y=0. groundAt(x, z) for every zone reads this one provider; the riverbed is carved by the river zone, not by a second height source.

landmarks.description: Suspension bridge spanning the river at x=6.

lighting.note: One global timeline. Every zone, effect and render reads sun position and night_factor from here; no zone may keep a private sun.

rules.reason: Nothing built or planted in the river; props and the bridge structure are exempt.
No buildings within 5 m of the great tree trunk (root zone).
East meadow stays low-rise so the wide shot keeps its skyline.

time.note: Action time is relative to the shot: each shot's t=0 is its own first frame. No builder may schedule action on whole-film absolute time.

zones.description: The river, flowing west to east.
Grove around the great tree (overlaps south_meadow).
